name: Remove the Qualifications column from the applicants table; keep the data in the CSV detail block and the details drawer
request: Remove the Qualifications column from the applicants table; keep the data in the CSV detail block and the details drawer
checks: npm run check passed (typecheck, build, 411 tests, validate)
result: The Qualifications column is gone from the applicants table, on request. Removed: the <th>, the <td> that rendered one <li> per requirement with its verdict mark, the now-unused VERDICT_MARK map and formatQualificationRow import, and the dead .verdict rules in applicants.css. Demoted rather than dropped, exactly as 3.7.4 treated resume_status and its two neighbours: qualifications leaves APPLICANT_TABLE_COLUMNS but stays in APPLICANT_CSV_COLUMNS as the first of the detail columns, so every requirement still exports with its category, verdict, explanation and source, and the details drawer still shows the must-have and preferred lists in full. Nothing about the applicant record, its parsing or its storage changed - only what the table paints. Two tests updated to the new truth: the CSV/table column test now asserts BOTH halves (the column is gone from the table AND the data still exports), and the visual-layer dynamic-class list drops matched/not_matched/unknown, which only the removed verdict mark emitted.
